summary: Implemented TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time with capture/clear logic in Progress.update/advance/reset, progress.elapsed style (yellow), Palette.__rich__, tests/test_palette.py, a test_time_elapsed_column test, the test_columns column-list and expected-output update, and a CHANGELOG Unreleased entry. Nothing committed. Tests were not run (repository code execution was disallowed), so test_columns' expected output is a hand trace of the clock reads, not verified by execution. Bar glyph counts (25 start rows, 16 finished rows) and the log-line padding were checked by grep, and the base file's bar counts (33 and 23) matched the layout model. Finished-frame bars shrink by 7 rather than 8 because the speed text narrows from 9 to 8 characters.
